description: This file defines API routes for session management, message handling, and file-pin operations using FastAPI. It interacts with a Supabase backend for data persistence and enforces user ownership via dependencies and RLS. Routes include listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting sessions, pinning files to sessions, and message exchange within sessions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sessions for the current user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new session for the current user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific session by its ID, verifying ownership.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the title of a session if owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a session owned by the current user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] pin_file_to_session(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Links a file to a session after ownership verification, idempotent operation.

methods.name: MessagesList list_session_messages(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all messages for a session owned by the current user, ordered ascending.

methods.name: MessagesList create_user_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a user message with a stub assistant reply, ensuring a file is pinned.

ctags.name: pin_file_to_session
ctags.pattern: /^def pin_file_to_session(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user)) -> Dict[s/
